dedupe_keys.name: loadiff cer 50 000 synthetic residential electricity load curves conditioned on appliance ownership

description: LoaDiff-CER: 50,000 Synthetic Residential Electricity Load Curves Conditioned on Appliance Ownership is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mariia Baranova, Adrien Petralia (EDF R&D, SEQUOIA, Palaiseau, France). This dataset provides 50,000 fully synthetic year-long residential electricity load curves at 30-minute resolution (17,520 points, in watts), generated by the LoaDiff diffusion model and conditioned on appliance-ownership attributes (cooker, dishwasher, tumble dryer, water heater) derived from the Irish CER Smart Metering dataset. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
